A nation’s ranking is calculated by the total points of the top five players on its submitted roster. Total of {{bgcolortext|up|96 Nations}} at the cut-off date will be eligible to host a '''National Qualifier''' and for all nations/rosters not covered through the VRS, FACEIT Elo Points will be used as second determining method. '''Cut-off date: June 22, 2026 - {{Countdown|date=2026-06-22 23:59 {{Abbr/AST}}|rawcountdown=true}}
Maximum of 3 Players from the same Organization per nation ===VRS Status=== [[Esports Nations Cup/2026|ENC 2026]] will be a '''VRS Tier 2''' event: * Teams appearing in the VRS prior to cut-off date (June 1) cannot have more than '''3''' players registered on a single team * Teams that release '''3''' of their core line-up into the ENC National teams will be able to earn VRS points through this event ==Projected Rankings== The following rankings are projections based on the highest-scoring theoretical roster. Once the final rosters are submitted and revealed, the rankings will be updated {{#invoke:Lua|invoke|module=NationsCup/DisplayRankings|fn=display|gameShortName=cs2|nations=true}} ==List of Events== All CS2 Tournaments accounted for the VRS taking place within the eligible period ==References== {{Reflist}}
